_format: Six broad policy axes. Each axis places 4 parties on (x: economic left/right -1..1, y: social libertarian/authoritarian -1..1) with a short justifying quote and a source citation (party + manifesto page). Quotes are verbatim from official 2024 GE manifestos.

labour.quote: Kickstart economic growth to secure the highest sustained growth in the G7, with good jobs and productivity growth in every part of the country making everyone, not just a few, better off.

conservative.quote: The economy is turning a corner because we built strong economic foundations before the pandemic and we have stuck to our plan.

libdem.quote: Liberal Democrats will build a strong, fair economy that benefits everyone in the UK.

snp.quote: We've grown the economy faster, per head, than the UK.

labour.quote: Labour's mission is to build an NHS fit for the future.

conservative.quote: Increase NHS spending above inflation every year, recruiting 92,000 more nurses and 28,000 more doctors.

libdem.quote: Give everyone the right to see a GP within seven days, or within 24 hours if they urgently need to, with 8,000 more GPs to deliver on it.

snp.quote: We have the best performing core A&E units in the UK.

labour.quote: Labour will recruit an additional 6,500 new expert teachers.

conservative.quote: We recruited record numbers of teachers to help our children become the best readers in the West.

libdem.quote: Putting a dedicated, qualified mental health professional in every school.

snp.quote: Defend free university tuition in Scotland. The SNP is the only party that will protect students and defend free education.

labour.quote: Labour will get Britain building again, creating jobs across England, with 1.5 million new homes over the next parliament.

conservative.quote: We will deliver 1.6 million homes in England in the next Parliament.

libdem.quote: Delivering a fair deal for renters by immediately banning no-fault evictions, making three-year tenancies the default, and creating a national register of licensed landlords.

snp.quote: We've built 40% more affordable homes per head than in England.

labour.quote: Labour will restore order to the asylum system so that it operates swiftly, firmly, and fairly; and the rules are properly enforced.

conservative.quote: Introduce a legal cap on migration to guarantee that numbers will fall every year, so public services are protected while bringing in the skills we need.

libdem.quote: Scrap the Conservatives' Illegal Migration Act and their Rwanda scheme, uphold the Refugee Convention, and provide safe and legal routes to sanctuary for refugees.

snp.quote: Devolve powers to create a bespoke migration system for Scotland.

labour.quote: Make Britain a clean energy superpower to cut bills, create jobs and deliver security with cheaper, zero-carbon electricity by 2030, accelerating to net zero.

conservative.quote: Delivering an affordable transition to domestic, sustainable energy.

libdem.quote: Take the action needed now to achieve net zero by 2045.

snp.quote: Deliver a fair and managed transition to net zero.
